newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Coelba bid specs available Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Coelba bid specs available Monday.

text.p: Full tender documents for the July 31 sale of Bahia state's power utility Coelba will be available to investors on June 9, the Bahia state government said in a published statement on Friday.
It said the tender details, which were published in the state's official gazette Thursday, and drafts of a concession contract will be sold for 300 reais.
The Brazilian state of Bahia will auction off 9.8 billion common shares or 65.64 percent of Coelba's voting capital for a minimum price of 975.8 million reais.
An additional 5.5 percent voting stake in Coelba will be offered to the firm's employees.
The shares will be sold at a closed-envelope privatization auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
So far about 10 groups have sought information on Coelba, including Brazilian companies and foreign investors from Portugal, the United States, Chile and France.

Coelba, formally known as Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia, posted a net profit of 4.3 million reais in the first quarter, against a 227.5 million real loss in the same period of last year.
